# Libraries used by the pages

Kept here instead of loading them from a CDN, so the phone app works without reaching
cdnjs/unpkg (slow or blocked in some places) and the pages also work offline.

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `qrcode.min.js` | qrcodejs (draws QR codes) | 1.0.0 | MIT, `LICENSE-qrcodejs.txt` | https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs |
| `JsBarcode.all.min.js` | JsBarcode (draws barcodes) | 3.12.3 | MIT, `LICENSE-JsBarcode.txt` | https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode |
| `html5-qrcode.min.js` | html5-qrcode (camera scanner in the browser) | 2.3.8 | Apache-2.0, `LICENSE-html5-qrcode.txt` | https://github.com/mebjas/html5-qrcode |

The same files the pages used to load from cdnjs.cloudflare.com and unpkg.com.
